card.name: Linking words in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "as", "depending", "either", "or" and a comma that come right after an instruction clause in dosing or monitoring directions. They introduce a condition, alternative or qualifier.

modes.label: as / depending qualifier
modes.description: "as" or "depending" after a discontinue or monitor instruction, leading into a condition such as clinically appropriate or severity.
modes.example: Consider discontinuation for Grade 3 infusions reactions<< as>> clinically appropriate considering individual benefits, risks,

modes.label: either / or alternatives
modes.description: "Either" or "or" that opens an alternative action in a dosing step.
modes.example: • <<Either>> resume at a reduced dose or discontinue

modes.label: comma before continuing
modes.description: A comma after "If needed" that leads into a continue-treatment instruction.

card.plain: It marks the small word in a dosing instruction that introduces a condition or an alternative.
